mapper.select: INSERT INTO provider_operations (stage_attempt_id, provider_key, provider_operation_id, status, request_fingerprint, normalized_result_json, result_fingerprint, reserved_at, completed_at, next_reconcile_at, reconcile_attempts, last_reconcile_error) VALUES (#{stageAttemptId}, #{providerKey}, #{providerOperationId}, #{status}, #{requestFingerprint}, CAST(#{normalizedResultJson} AS jsonb), #{resultFingerprint}, COALESCE(#{reservedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{completedAt}, #{nextReconcileAt}, #{reconcileAttempts}, #{lastReconcileError}) ON CONFLICT (provider_key, request_fingerprint) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE provider_operations SET stage_attempt_id = #{stageAttemptId}, provider_key = #{providerKey}, provider_operation_id = #{providerOperationId}, status = #{status}, request_fingerprint = #{requestFingerprint}, normalized_result_json = CAST(#{normalizedResultJson} AS jsonb), result_fingerprint = #{resultFingerprint}, reserved_at = #{reservedAt}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, next_reconcile_at = #{nextReconcileAt}, reconcile_attempts = #{reconcileAttempts}, last_reconcile_error = #{lastReconcileError}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND row_version = #{rowVersion}

UPDATE provider_operations SET status = 'UNKNOWN', next_reconcile_at = #{nextReconcileAt}, last_reconcile_error = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('RESERVED', 'SUBMITTED', 'RUNNING') AND row_version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE provider_operations SET status = 'COMPLETED', provider_operation_id = COALESCE(#{providerOperationId}, provider_operation_id), normalized_result_json = CAST(#{normalizedResultJson} AS jsonb), result_fingerprint = #{resultFingerprint}, completed_at = COALESCE(completed_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), next_reconcile_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('UNKNOWN', 'SUBMITTED', 'RUNNING') AND row_version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE provider_operations SET reconcile_attempts = reconcile_attempts + 1, next_reconcile_at = #{nextReconcileAt}, last_reconcile_error = #{error}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('UNKNOWN', 'SUBMITTED', 'RUNNING') AND row_version = #{expectedVersion}
